articles.title: Can a 38-Year-Old Soccer Star Help America Fall in Love with the World Cup?
articles.summary: Tim Ream, 38, hopes to make the U.S. team for the 2026 World Cup. He wants to inspire kids to love soccer, just like the 1994 World Cup did when he was 6.

articles.title: Europe's Crazy Spring Heat Wave Breaks 100-Year-Old Records!
articles.summary: The UK hit 95.2°F, breaking a record from 1922. France and Spain also saw extreme heat. At least 11 people died trying to cool off in water. Scientists say climate change made it worse.

articles.title: Armenia Signs Big Deal with the U.S.—But Russia Isn't Happy
articles.summary: Armenia signed a partnership with the U.S. to build a 27-mile corridor called TRIPP. It will connect Azerbaijan to Turkey. But Russia, Armenia's old ally, might raise gas prices in response.
